dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: As long as you are careful, focused, and feel for it with all your heart, you'll know exactly where it is — the Witch's "grand prize" is buried deep beneath those snowdrifts!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I win the grand prize too?

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: Of course. As the Witch's representative, I am here to offer you guidance. Keep in mind, however, that you only get <color=#00E1FFFF>five tries</color> to win the grand prize...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, you're practically surrounded by jack frosts!

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: Heh, these little fellas... Back when I used to sweep snow off the streets, I'd always find a few that had gotten themselves trapped. I'd help them out, so they started following me everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: Now that I'm retired and not out clearing the streets anymore, they come to keep me company and float all around my stall instead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I haven't too much time at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: No worries. Take care of your own business first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't they ever cause any mischief?

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: Haha, of course not! Honestly, they're quite the little "witches" themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: They shape the snow into perfectly identical piles, hide inside one of them, and then reset all the shoveled snow back to normal after every round.

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: These cute little fellas really save me a lot of trouble...
